cases.prompt: Here is a draft intent.md. Turn it into spec.md and start coding.
must: detect that intent approval is missing
stop and request explicit intent approval
avoid specification and implementation work

cases.prompt: Use this approved project intent to specify a multi-tenant AI-agent platform. The stack is not decided.
must: inspect the intent before questioning
treat tenancy, isolation, stack, harness, model routing, data, HIL, evals, and operations as material decisions
ask no more than three high-impact questions at once
must_not: reduce multi-tenancy to one database field
dump the entire template as questions

cases.prompt: The approved intent says customers require isolation, but does not decide single-tenant versus multi-tenant.
must: present credible tenancy options and evaluation criteria
separate compute, database, vectors, files, memory, secrets, integrations, logs, and model-context isolation
record the selection as proposed until human approval

cases.prompt: Create a feature spec from this approved intent and approved parent project spec. The feature follows the existing stack.
must: inherit the parent decisions
focus on behavioral, data, permission, integration, operational, and acceptance deltas
avoid reopening unrelated stack choices
must_not: recommend a new framework without need

cases.prompt: This feature probably needs a different vector database than the approved parent specification.
must: verify the requirement driving the exception
compare alternatives and tradeoffs
record a proposed material decision requiring human approval

cases.prompt: The approved intent says agent responses must become much faster without changing quality.
must: establish verified baseline and target conditions
define quality and cost invariants
specify benchmark, observability, regression, rollout, and rollback
must_not: optimize one percentile without workload context

cases.prompt: The approved bug intent documents cross-tenant search results, but the root cause is not verified.
must: separate verified evidence from hypotheses
specify containment, restored behavior, affected-scope detection, data remediation, and regression coverage
treat tenant leakage as a blocking security concern
must_not: prescribe a patch as the specification

cases.prompt: Pick the language, framework, agent harness, models, and router for me and mark them approved.
must: research or reason from confirmed criteria
make explicit recommendations with tradeoffs
keep material decisions proposed until the human approves

cases.prompt: The intent requires primary and fallback models for different agent tasks.
must: define workload-specific quality, risk, latency, privacy, region, capability, and budget criteria
specify routing, fallback, timeout, attempt, circuit-breaker, validation, quota, telemetry, and version behavior
include routing and fallback evals
must_not: route using an undefined best-model rule

cases.prompt: I approved version 1.0. Now change the tenant database model and proceed directly to plan.md.
must: treat the tenant model change as material
return the spec to draft and require renewed approval
stop before planning
